name: Wu-Tang x Nike Dunk High Retro Premium 2024
story_html: The 2024 edition of the Wu-Tang x Nike Dunk High Retro Premium brings back a highly sought-after colorway that surfaced in 1999 as an extremely limited friends-and-family release. Based on the classic 'Iowa' Dunk from Nike's original Be True to Your School series, the high-top utilizes a smooth leather upper, featuring a solid black base with Goldenrod overlays and a color-matched Swoosh. The Wu-Tang Clan's stylized 'W' logo decorates the tongue tag and lateral heel.
